title: evolution of carbon emission efficiency in the construction industry: evidence from guangdong-fujian-zhejiang coastal urban agglomeration in china
core_idea: Clarify the changing characteristics and cyclical evolution of carbon emission efficiency in the construction industry across the Guangdong–Fujian–Zhejiang coastal urban agglomeration by establishing an evaluation framework for 2013–2022 using an unexpected-output slack-based measure model; use data envelopment analysis to examine static distribution and the Malmquist productivity index to assess dynamic evolution, and develop synergistic carbon-reduction strategies to support coordinated regional low-carbon development.
tldr: Evaluate and track spatio-temporal evolution of construction-sector carbon emission efficiency (2013–2022) in the Guangdong–Fujian–Zhejiang coastal agglomeration using an unexpected-output SBM, DEA, and Malmquist index to inform coordinated regional low-carbon strategies.
